tools.name: find_dealer
tools.description: Lists the Solasta dealers that install in a US ZIP code, with their website and phone.

tools.name: get_dealer_info
tools.description: The dealer's contact details, where it installs, and how its estimates work.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The dealer's lighting products with list prices: rails priced per foot (with their colors), fixed costs and add-ons, and current public promotions.

tools.name: estimate_from_address
tools.description: A quick, rough price range from the address alone: the building's outline from map data gives its perimeter. Use coverage "front" when the person only wants the front of the house (counted as 30% of the perimeter). The range is wide; offer estimate_from_kml for a tighter one.

tools.name: kml_instructions
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions for dropping roofline pins in Google Earth and exporting them as a KML file, named so the dealer can measure them.

tools.name: check_kml
tools.description: Reads a roofline KML the way the installer's tools do: the pins, the lit runs and their feet by side, and plain-language problems to fix. Nothing is saved.

tools.name: estimate_from_kml
tools.description: A tighter price range from the person's roofline KML (check it with check_kml first). Needs the ZIP code for the right dealer and sales tax.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends the person's details to the dealer, who will contact them to confirm the roofline and give a firm quote. Only call it after the person has asked for a quote and confirmed their details. Set smsConsent to true only if the person explicitly agreed to receive text messages.
